definition_zh: 记者；报道者；报告人
definition_en: a person whose job is to gather news and tell the public about it
core_image: 拿着话筒和笔记本的人，把远处的消息带回编辑部
scene: 发布会还没结束，前排的记者已经把要点发回编辑部。 The reporter filed the story before the room emptied.
sceneCN: 这里 reporter 是「记者」（第 1 个义项：采集并报道新闻的人）；句意：记者在会场散场前就把报道发了回去。

senses.title: A news journalist
senses.definition: a person who collects information and writes or broadcasts news
senses.definitionCN: 采集信息并撰写或播报新闻的人
senses.example: A reporter stopped him outside the station.
senses.exampleCN: 一名记者在车站外拦住了他。
senses.why: The -er ending marks the person who performs the action of reporting, so the basic sense is the news worker.
senses.whyCN: -er 词尾标记执行 report 这一动作的人，所以基本义就是新闻工作者。

senses.title: A person who reports something
senses.definition: someone who gives an official account of an event to an authority
senses.definitionCN: 向权威机构正式说明某事件的人
senses.example: The reporter of the accident gave a clear statement.
senses.exampleCN: 事故报告人作了清楚的陈述。
senses.why: Anyone who carries information to an authority can be called a reporter, not only a journalist.
senses.whyCN: 任何把信息带给权威机构的人都可以叫 reporter，并不限于记者。

senses.title: A court stenographer
senses.definition: a person who records the words spoken in a court
senses.definitionCN: 记录法庭上发言内容的人
senses.example: The court reporter typed every word of the testimony.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭记录员打下了证词的每一个字。
senses.why: Recording speech for the record is another specialised form of reporting what was said.
senses.whyCN: 为存档记录发言，是「报告所说内容」的另一种专业形式。

intro.en: Reporter is report plus the agent ending -er, so it names the person who carries information back.
intro.cn: reporter 是 report 加施事词尾 -er，指把信息带回来的人。

items.en: Reportare means to carry back news, from re- and portare.
items.cn: reportare 意为带回消息，由 re- 与 portare 构成。

items.en: Old French reporter supplies the verb that English shortens to report.
items.cn: 古法语 reporter 提供动词，英语将其简化为 report。

items.en: Middle English report names both the telling and the account.
items.cn: 中古英语 report 既指讲述，也指叙述。

items.en: The agent noun reporter appears for someone who brings news.
items.cn: 施事名词 reporter 出现，指带来消息的人。

items.en: Newspapers make reporter a regular job title.
items.cn: 报纸使 reporter 成为固定的职业名称。

items.en: Modern English extends it to court recorders and official informants.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到法庭记录员和正式报告人。

note.en: Reporter is the person noun of the report family, and it sits beside other names for news workers.
note.cn: reporter 是 report 词族中表示人的名词，与其它新闻工作者名称相邻。

entries.definition: to give an account of something
entries.definitionCN: 报告；报道

entries.definition: according to what is said
entries.definitionCN: 据报道

entries.definition: the style of written news reporting
entries.definitionCN: 报道文体

entries.definition: a person who writes for newspapers or broadcasts
entries.definitionCN: 新闻工作者

entries.definition: a reporter based in a particular place or field
entries.definitionCN: 驻外记者；通讯员

entries.definition: a writer who produces a regular opinion column
entries.definitionCN: 专栏作家

entries.definition: a person who reads news or introduces programmes
entries.definitionCN: 播音员；报幕员

normalIntro.en: Reporter is report plus -er, so the spelling itself says a person who reports.
normalIntro.cn: reporter 就是 report 加 -er，拼写本身就在说「做报道的人」。

normal.en: Report plus -er: the one who carries the news back.
normal.cn: report 加 -er：把消息带回来的人。

normal.en: A news reporter works where events are happening.
normal.cn: news reporter 工作在事件发生的地方。

normal.en: An investigative reporter digs for hidden facts.
normal.cn: investigative reporter 专门挖掘隐藏的事实。

normal.en: A court reporter records what is said in court.
normal.cn: court reporter 记录法庭上的发言。

normal.en: Compare report and reporter: one is the act, one is the person.
normal.cn: 对比 report 与 reporter：一个是动作，一个是人。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook and microphone moving through a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象笔记本和话筒在人群中移动。

abstract.en: Imagine a press pass hanging from a lanyard at the front row.
abstract.cn: 想象前排挂着记者证的挂绳。

abstract.en: Think of a voice sending facts from a dark street into a bright studio.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音把事实从暗街送进明亮的演播室。

examples.en: The reporter interviewed three witnesses.
examples.cn: 记者采访了三名目击者。

examples.en: She works as a sports reporter for a local paper.
examples.cn: 她在一家地方报纸做体育记者。

examples.en: Reporters waited outside the court for a statement.
examples.cn: 记者们在法庭外等待声明。

dict_mnemonic.text: report（报道）+ -er（做某事的人）＝记者；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: report（报告，源自拉丁语 reportare「带回」）+ 施事词尾 -er，指采集并传递消息的人。

sensesIntro.en: The suffix -er gives the person: first the news worker, then anyone who reports officially, then the court recorder.
sensesIntro.cn: 词尾 -er 给出「人」：先是新闻工作者，再是任何正式报告者，最后是法庭记录员。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person carrying news from the scene back to the desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人把消息从现场带回编辑桌。

branches.en: The news worker is the everyday and central sense.
branches.cn: 新闻工作者，是最日常、最核心的义项。

branches.en: Anyone who gives an official account is a reporter in the broad sense.
branches.cn: 任何作出正式陈述的人，都是广义上的报告人。

branches.en: The court recorder reports speech into a permanent record.
branches.cn: 法庭记录员把发言报告成永久记录。

branches.en: Journalist and official informant both carry information to others.
branches.cn: 记者与正式报告人都在把信息带给他人。

branches.en: Both gather words at the scene and preserve them for later readers.
branches.cn: 两者都在现场收集话语，并为后来的读者保存。

intro.en: Reporter is a transparent English agent noun: report plus -er.
intro.cn: reporter 是一个构词透明的英语施事名词：report 加 -er。

latinIntro.en: The base report comes from Latin reportare, to carry back, and -er marks the person who does it.
latinIntro.cn: 基础词 report 来自拉丁语 reportare（带回），-er 标记执行该动作的人。

items.example: Report is the base of reporter.
items.exampleCN: report 是 reporter 的基础词。

items.example: The suffix -er turns report into reporter.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 把 report 变成 reporter。

items.example: Reporter joins report and -er.
items.exampleCN: reporter 由 report 与 -er 合成。

items.example: Reporters adds -s to reporter.
Reportage shares the report stem.
items.exampleCN: reportage 共享 report 词干。

items.meaningCN: 表示集合或过程的名词词尾
items.example: The ending -age forms reportage.
Reportedly shares the report stem.
items.exampleCN: reportedly 共享 report 词干。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms reportedly.

definition_zh: 模型；按比例缩小的复制品；模特；模范；产品的型号；（科学、数学或计算机的）简化表示；按模型塑造；以……为原型
definition_en: a small copy or simplified representation of something, a person who poses, an example worth copying, or the act of shaping something after a pattern
core_image: 桌上摆着一辆按比例缩小的木制车身，旁边摊着同样线条的图纸
scene: 展厅中央摆着一辆缩小一半的样车，观众围着看比例与线条。 The clay model shows the new body shape before any metal is cut.
sceneCN: 这里指按比例做成的实物样件（第 1 个义项：缩小的复制品）；句意为这个黏土样件在任何金属被切割之前就展示了新车身的形状。图中可辨识物件：展台、样车、比例尺、射灯；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 模型；复制品；模特；模范；型号
制作模型；塑造；展示服装；以……为原型

senses.title: A small copy of a thing
senses.definition: a representation of an object, usually smaller and often built to scale
senses.definitionCN: 某物的再现，通常更小，且常按比例制作
senses.example: The museum displayed a model of the ship.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆展出了那艘船的模型。
senses.why: The word began as a measured pattern, and the first thing a pattern produces is a reduced copy.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指量出来的样板，而样板造出的第一件东西就是缩小的复制件。

senses.title: A person who poses
senses.titleCN: 摆姿势供人描绘或拍摄的人
senses.definition: a person who poses for artists, photographers or fashion shows
senses.definitionCN: 为画家、摄影师或时装表演摆姿势的人
senses.example: She worked as a model for a clothing catalogue.
senses.exampleCN: 她为一份服装目录做模特。
senses.why: A living body can also stand in for an ideal body, so the copy became a person.
senses.whyCN: 活人的身体也能充当理想身体的替身，于是复制件变成了人。

senses.title: An example worth copying
senses.definition: a person or thing whose behaviour is held up for others to imitate
senses.definitionCN: 其行为被举出来供他人模仿的人或事物
senses.example: Older students serve as models for the younger ones.
senses.exampleCN: 高年级学生为低年级学生做榜样。
senses.why: Once a copy is approved, it becomes the pattern that the next copy must follow.
senses.whyCN: 一旦某个复制件被认可，它就变成下一个复制件必须遵循的样板。

senses.title: A version of a product
senses.definition: one of the versions in which a product is made and sold
senses.definitionCN: 产品被制造与出售的若干版本之一
senses.example: The new model has a longer battery life.
senses.exampleCN: 新型号的电池续航更长。
senses.why: Factories issue each version as a pattern to be copied on the line, so the version itself is called a model.
senses.whyCN: 工厂把每个版本当作流水线上要复制的样板发下去，于是版本本身就被称为型号。

senses.title: A simplified scientific picture
senses.definition: a simplified description of a system that keeps its main features and drops the rest
senses.definitionCN: 保留主要特征、舍弃其余细节的系统简化描述
senses.example: The model explains how heat moves through the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个模型解释了热如何穿过墙壁。
senses.why: Science replaces the whole object with a stand-in small enough to reason about.
senses.whyCN: 科学用一个小到可以推理的替身来取代整个对象。

senses.title: A set of equations
senses.definition: a mathematical representation whose relations can be solved or simulated
senses.definitionCN: 一种关系可被求解或模拟的数学表示
senses.example: A simple model predicts the queue length.
senses.exampleCN: 一个简单模型能预测排队长度。
senses.why: When the copy is made of relations rather than material, it can be calculated.
senses.whyCN: 当复制件的材质从实物换成关系，它就可以被计算。

senses.title: A computer representation
senses.definition: a program and its data built to imitate a system's behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 为模仿系统行为而建立的程序及其数据
senses.example: Engineers ran the model overnight to test the design.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师整夜运行模型来检验设计。
senses.why: The calculating copy finally moved into a machine, where it could be run again and again.
senses.whyCN: 会计算的复制件最终搬进机器，可以在那里一遍遍运行。

senses.title: To shape something
senses.definition: to form a material into a shape, especially by hand
senses.definitionCN: 把材料做成某种形状，尤指用手
senses.example: He modeled the figure in clay.
senses.exampleCN: 他用黏土塑出那个人像。
senses.why: The verb returns to the workshop: the hand making the copy is the oldest action in the word.
senses.whyCN: 动词回到工坊：手做出复制件，是这个词里最古老的动作。

senses.title: To display clothes
senses.definition: to wear clothes for photographs or a show in order to display them
senses.definitionCN: 穿着服装供拍照或走秀以展示它们
senses.example: They model winter coats in the show.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在秀场上展示冬季外套。
senses.why: The posing sense became a verb when the profession turned the body into a display surface.
senses.whyCN: 当这一职业把身体变成展示面，摆姿势这层意思就动词化了。

senses.title: To base something on
senses.definition: to build or design something using another thing as the pattern
senses.definitionCN: 以另一事物为样板来建造或设计
senses.example: The design was modeled on a fishing boat.
senses.exampleCN: 这个设计是以一艘渔船为原型做的。
senses.why: The noun's pattern sense became a verb of copying, which is the last step in the chain.
senses.whyCN: 名词的样板义变成表示复制的动词，这是整条链上的最后一步。

intro.en: Model entered English from French modelle, from Italian modello, from a reconstructed Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus 'small measure'. The Latin base is modus 'measure'.
intro.cn: model 经法语 modelle、意大利语 modello 进入英语，更早是俗拉丁语中 modulus「小量度」的一个重构指小形式；拉丁语基底为 modus「量度」。

items.en: Latin modus meant measure, manner or limit and underlies mode, moderate and modulus.
items.cn: 拉丁 modus 指量度、方式或限度，是 mode、moderate 与 modulus 的基底。

items.en: Modulus, a small measure or standard unit, was used of a mould, a model and a rhythmic unit.
items.cn: modulus 指小量度或标准单位，曾用于模具、模型与节律单位。

items.en: A Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus is reconstructed behind the Italian and French words; it is a reconstructed form rather than an attested record.
items.cn: 意大利语与法语词背后的俗拉丁语指小形式为重构所得，是重构形式，并非有记录的词。

items.en: Italian modello named a small copy or a pattern, and the artist's model of the Renaissance made the word common.
items.cn: 意大利语 modello 指小复制件或样板；文艺复兴时期画家的模特使这个词通行。

items.en: French modelle carried the word into English in the sixteenth century, first as an architect's pattern and a small copy.
items.cn: 法语 modelle 在十六世纪把词带入英语，最初指建筑师的样板与小复制件。

items.en: English extended the copy to a posing person, then to an example, a product version and a scientific schema; the verb followed in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语把这层复制义扩展到摆姿势的人，再扩展到榜样、产品型号与科学图式；动词用法在十七世纪跟上。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like model; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「model」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: A measured unit or separable part, from the same small-measure root.
entries.definitionCN: 量度单位或可拆分部件，同出那个「小量度」词根。

entries.definition: Relating to mode or manner, as in grammar or music; it keeps the abstract side of modus.
entries.definitionCN: 与方式或调式相关，如语法或音乐；它保留 modus 抽象的一面。

entries.definition: To interfere in others' affairs; it looks close but has no connection with measure.
entries.definitionCN: 插手他人的事；形近，但与「量度」无关。

entries.definition: A person who builds models, formed with the agent suffix.
entries.definitionCN: 建造模型的人，由施动后缀构成。

entries.definition: A hollow shape for casting, from Latin modulus but through a different path; it is the tool, not the copy.
entries.definitionCN: 用于浇铸的空腔形状，虽源于拉丁 modulus，但走的是另一条路径；它是工具，不是复制件。

entries.definition: A copy made to match an original closely, often at full size.
entries.definitionCN: 为贴近原物而做的复制件，常为原尺寸。

entries.definition: The first full working version from which later copies are developed.
entries.definitionCN: 第一个可工作的完整版本，后续复制件由它发展而来。

entries.definition: An original pattern or ideal that later things are said to follow.
entries.definitionCN: 后世事物被认为遵循的原初范式或理想。

entries.definition: An imitation that is run or observed rather than held in the hand.
entries.definitionCN: 被运行或观察、而非拿在手里的仿制品。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin measure word, the real family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「量度」词、真实同族词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Latin modus means measure, so a model is a thing measured out to stand for another.
normal.cn: 拉丁 modus 意为量度，因此模型就是量出来代替另一物的东西。

normal.en: The family runs model, modeling, modeler, modeled and remodel.
normal.cn: 同族词有 model、modeling、modeler、modeled 与 remodel。

normal.en: Fixed phrases cover the senses: scale model, role model, fashion model, business model.
normal.cn: 固定说法覆盖各义：比例模型、榜样、时装模特、商业模式。

normal.en: The verb phrase model on keeps the old pattern sense alive.
normal.cn: 动词短语 model on 保留着古老的样板义。

normal.en: British English writes modelled and modelling with a doubled l.
normal.cn: 英式英语把过去式与现在分词写成双写 l 的 modelled 与 modelling。

abstract.en: A model is a stand-in you can hold, rotate and point at.
abstract.cn: 模型是一个能拿住、转动并指给人看的替身。

abstract.en: A role model is the same stand-in made of a person's conduct.
abstract.cn: 榜样是用一个人的行为做成的同一个替身。

abstract.en: A computer model is a copy with no weight, run again and again.
abstract.cn: 计算机模型是一个没有重量的复制件，可以一遍遍运行。

examples.en: The engineer built a scale model before the full bridge was ordered.
examples.cn: 工程师在整座桥下单之前做了一个比例模型。

examples.en: Her calm reply became a model for the whole team.
examples.cn: 她沉着的回答成了整个团队的榜样。

examples.en: The lab models the river's flow on a supercomputer.
examples.cn: 实验室在一台超级计算机上模拟这条河的流量。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「模」就是模子，「豆」是小粒——照着模子倒出小粒，就是模型

root: 拉丁 modus「量度」→ modulus「小量度」→ 俗拉丁语指小形式（重构形式）→ 意大利 modello／法语 modelle→ 英语 model。与 mode、moderate、module 同根；与 meddle「插手」形近但无词源关系。

sensesIntro.en: Ten senses follow one measured stand-in: a reduced copy, a posing body, an example, a product version, a scientific picture, equations, a computer representation, the act of shaping, the act of displaying, and the act of basing on.
sensesIntro.cn: 十个义项跟着同一个量出来的替身：缩小的复制件、摆姿势的身体、榜样、产品型号、科学图景、方程、计算机表示、塑造的动作、展示的动作，以及以之为原型的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a scaled wooden body on a table, with the same lines drawn on paper beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上放着一具按比例缩小的木制车身，旁边摊着画出同样线条的图纸。

branches.en: THE COPY MADE BY HAND: a reduced object is built, and the hand that builds it is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 亲手做出的复制件：一个缩小的物件被造出来，造它的那只手是最古老的一层。

branches.en: THE POSING BODY: a living person stands in for an ideal body, and the same act becomes a verb.
branches.cn: 摆姿势的身体：活人替理想身体站台，同一个动作又动词化。

branches.en: THE APPROVED PATTERN: a copy that has won approval becomes the thing others must follow.
branches.cn: 被认可的样板：赢得认可的复制件变成他人必须跟随的东西。

branches.en: THE PRODUCT VERSION: a factory issues each version as the pattern to copy on the line.
branches.cn: 产品型号：工厂把每个版本当作流水线上要复制的样板。

branches.en: THE CALCULATED STAND-IN: a picture, a set of equations, a program, or the act of building on a pattern.
branches.cn: 被计算的替身：一幅图景、一组方程、一个程序，或以样板为据来建造的动作。

intro.en: Model is built on the Latin measure word modus, with the Latin diminutive modulus behind it.
intro.cn: model 建立在拉丁语「量度」词 modus 之上，背后还有拉丁指小词 modulus。

latinIntro.en: Latin modus gives modulus; a reconstructed Vulgar Latin diminutive passes through Italian modello and French modelle into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 modus 衍生 modulus；一个重构的俗拉丁语指小形式经意大利 modello 与法语 modelle 进入英语。

items.example: The base of the whole family.
The small unit that becomes a pattern.
Italian gave the artist's model and the architect's pattern.
items.exampleCN: 意大利语给出画家模特与建筑师样板。

items.example: French carried the word into English.

items.meaning: a copy; a pattern; to shape
items.example: English widened and verbalised the word.
items.exampleCN: 英语把词义扩大并动词化。

items.example: The activity suffix names the work.
items.exampleCN: 活动后缀命名这项工作。

items.example: The agent suffix names the maker.
The prefix repeats the shaping.
It keeps the abstract branch of modus.
items.exampleCN: 它保留 modus 的抽象分支。

items.example: The same measure builds a part.

definition_zh: 领导者；带头人；领先者；（英）社论；（钓鱼）前导线；乐团首席
definition_en: a person or thing that guides, directs or is ahead of others
core_image: 队伍最前面的人回头看了一眼，确认后面的人都还跟着，然后继续走
scene: 出发前，队伍最前面的人回头清点人数，确认没有人掉队才继续前进。 The group chose a new leader before the season began.
sceneCN: 这里指「带领群体的那个人」（第 1 个义项：群体的领导者）；句意为赛季开始前，这个团体选出了一位新的领导者。可辨识物件：队伍、背包、路口、名册、手杖。

pos.zh: 领先者；领先企业或产品

derivatives.zh: 带领（过去式与过去分词）

senses.title: The person who guides a group
senses.definition: a person who directs the movement or activity of a group and whom others follow
senses.definitionCN: 指引一个群体的行动或活动、并被他人跟随的人
senses.example: The group chose a new leader before the season began.
senses.exampleCN: 赛季开始前，这个团体选出了一位新的领导者。
senses.why: The verb means 'to cause to go', and the agent ending marks the one who does the causing.
senses.whyCN: 动词意为「使行走」，施事后缀标记的正是那个发出使动的人。

senses.title: The head of an organization or government
senses.definition: the person holding the highest office in a party, union, company or state
senses.definitionCN: 在政党、工会、公司或国家中占据最高职位的人
senses.example: Union leaders met the minister on Tuesday.
senses.exampleCN: 工会领袖们在周二会见了部长。
senses.why: A group large enough to have offices needs a person at the top of its chart, and that person is its leader.
senses.whyCN: 一个大到设有办公室的群体，需要在组织图顶端有一个人，这个人就是它的领导者。

senses.title: The one in front of a race
senses.definition: the competitor currently ahead of all others in a race or contest
senses.definitionCN: 在赛跑或竞赛中目前领先于所有其他人的人
senses.example: The leader pulled away on the final climb.
senses.exampleCN: 领先者在最后一段爬坡时拉开了距离。
senses.why: The same word covers physical position: whoever is furthest along the course is simply the one leading.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也覆盖物理位置：在赛道上走得最远的人，自然就是领跑者。

senses.title: The top firm or product
senses.titleCN: 市场中最领先的企业或产品
senses.definition: the company or brand with the largest share or strongest position in a market
senses.definitionCN: 在市场中份额最大或地位最强的公司或品牌
senses.example: The company is the market leader in small turbines.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司是小型涡轮机市场的领先者。
senses.why: Markets are treated as races, so the firm furthest ahead carries the name of the runner in front.
senses.whyCN: 市场被当作赛跑，因此跑得最远的公司就带上了最前面那位选手的名称。

senses.title: A leading newspaper article
senses.definition: in British usage, the main editorial that states the paper's opinion
senses.definitionCN: 英式用法中指表明报纸立场的主要社论
senses.example: The newspaper's leader criticized the plan as too costly.
senses.exampleCN: 该报的社论批评这项计划代价过高。
senses.why: The article that stands at the head of the opinion page is literally the leading piece.
senses.whyCN: 站在评论版最前面的那篇文章，字面上就是「领头的」那篇。

senses.title: The line between fly and fish
senses.titleCN: 鱼线与假饵之间的前导线
senses.definition: in angling, the length of line attached between the main line and the hook or fly
senses.definitionCN: 钓鱼时连接主线与鱼钩或假饵的那段线
senses.example: He tied a longer leader to the fly line before casting.
senses.exampleCN: 抛竿之前，他在飞蝇线上接了一段更长的前导线。
senses.why: The leader goes in front of the main line and leads the fly to the fish, so angling borrowed the ordinary word.
senses.whyCN: 前导线走在主线之前，把假饵引向鱼，钓鱼术语因此借用了这个普通词。

senses.title: The first chair in an orchestra
senses.definition: the principal player, especially the first violinist, who leads the section and stands in for the conductor
senses.definitionCN: 主要演奏者，尤指首席小提琴手，负责带领声部并在需要时代行指挥
senses.example: The orchestra's leader tuned the strings before the overture.
senses.exampleCN: 乐团首席在序曲之前为弦乐调音。
senses.why: Music uses the word for the player who stands first and gives the cue to the section.
senses.whyCN: 音乐用这个词指站在最前面、向声部发出提示的演奏者。

senses.title: The person who takes a group up a mountain
senses.definition: a qualified person who guides a group along a route and takes responsibility for its safety
senses.definitionCN: 沿路线引导团队并对安全负责的合格人员
senses.example: The mountain leader checked every rope before the descent.
senses.exampleCN: 登山向导在下撤之前检查了每一根绳索。
senses.why: Guidance on a route is the oldest sense of leading: someone who knows the way walks in front.
senses.whyCN: 在路线上引导是「带领」最古老的义项：知道路的人走在前面。

intro.en: Leader is lead plus the agent ending -er. Lead comes from Old English lǣdan 'to lead, guide', a causative form related to līþan 'to go, travel'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: leader 由 lead 加施事后缀构成。lead 出自古英语 lǣdan「带领、引导」，是与 līþan「行走、旅行」相关的使役形式。年代均为约数。

items.en: Līþan meant 'to go, travel'. Its earlier Germanic source is reconstructed rather than directly attested.
items.cn: līþan 意为「行走、旅行」。它在日耳曼语中更早的来源属于重构，而非直接有据。

items.en: Lǣdan was the causative partner, meaning 'to make go, conduct, guide'.
items.cn: lǣdan 是对应的使役词，意为「使行走、引导、带领」。

items.en: The ending -er marks the doer. English had a native agent ending, later reinforced by French -ier from Latin -arius.
items.cn: 这个施事后缀标记动作的执行者。英语本有本土的施事后缀，后来受到法语中源自拉丁语的相应后缀加强。

items.en: Leader named the person who conducts others, and by the seventeenth century it also named the first person in a race.
items.cn: leader 指带领他人的人；到十七世纪，它也指赛跑中最前面的人。

items.en: Angling, music and journalism each gave the word a narrow use, from the line before the fly to the article before the editorial page.
items.cn: 钓鱼、音乐与新闻各自赋予这个词专门用法，从假饵之前的线，到评论版最前面的文章。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Germanic source of līþan is a reconstruction, and no exact first citation is fixed for the angling sense, so dates here are approximations.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：līþan 在日耳曼语之前的来源属于重构形式；钓鱼义也没有确切的最早书证，因此这里给出的年代均为约数。

note.en: Group one holds the same guiding family; group two holds nouns for the person at the head of a group.
note.cn: 第一组是同出「引导」词族的词；第二组是表示群体首位者的名词。

entries.definition: To guide or be first; the person noun is built directly on this verb.
entries.definitionCN: 引导或处于首位；这个表示人的名词直接由该动词构成。

entries.definition: Means guiding or ahead; it describes the position rather than the person.
entries.definitionCN: 意为「引导的」或「领先的」；描述位置，而非人。

entries.definition: The ability, position or body of leaders; it surrounds the person with a role.
entries.definitionCN: 领导能力、职位或领导层；它把这个人包在一个角色里。

entries.definition: To guide in the wrong direction; it shares the walking root but reverses the purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 把人引向错误方向；共享「行走」词根，却把目的反转。

entries.definition: The person in charge of an organization; it stresses office more than the act of guiding.
entries.definitionCN: 一个组织的主管者；强调职位，而非引导的动作。

entries.definition: The highest-ranking person in a body, often in a traditional or official title.
entries.definitionCN: 某个机构中地位最高的人，常用于传统或官方头衔。

entries.definition: A person who opens a new field or route; a leader can follow an existing path, a pioneer cannot.
entries.definitionCN: 开辟新领域或新路线的人；领导者可以走已有的路，先驱则不能。

entries.definition: The competitor thought most likely to win; it is close to the race sense of leader.
entries.definitionCN: 被认为最可能获胜的竞争者；接近 leader 的赛跑义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real walking root, the real agent ending and the real institutional phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的「行走」词根、真实的施事后缀与真实的机构搭配。

normal.en: The verb means 'to cause to go', and the ending means 'the one who', so a leader is the one who makes others go.
normal.cn: 动词意为「使行走」，后缀意为「……的人」，因此领导者就是使他人前进的人。

normal.en: The family runs lead, leader, leading, led, leadership, mislead and leaderless.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 lead、leader、leading、led、leadership、mislead 与 leaderless。

normal.en: The organizational phrases are team leader, world leader and leader of the opposition.
normal.cn: 组织搭配有团队负责人、世界领导人与反对党领袖。

normal.en: The market phrase is market leader, and the everyday phrase is follow the leader.
normal.cn: 市场搭配是市场领先者，日常说法是跟着领头的人做。

normal.en: The same root appears in mislead, where the guiding is deliberately wrong.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在 mislead 中，那里的引导是故意走错方向。

abstract.en: Picture someone at the front of a column who turns back to count the walkers.
abstract.cn: 想象队伍最前面的人回头清点人数。

abstract.en: Picture a runner whose back is the only thing the others can see.
abstract.cn: 想象一名跑者，其他人只看得见他的背影。

abstract.en: Picture a first violinist raising the bow so that an entire section know when to begin.
abstract.cn: 想象首席小提琴手举起弓，让整个声部知道何时开始。

examples.en: A good leader makes the next decision easier for everyone else.
examples.cn: 好的领导者会让其他人做下一个决定时更容易。

examples.en: The market leader cut prices before the smaller firms could respond.
examples.cn: 市场领先者在较小公司来得及反应之前就降了价。

examples.en: The newspaper's leader called for an independent inquiry.
examples.cn: 该报的社论要求进行独立调查。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「带领」加「人」——走在最前、让别人跟着走的那个人 → 领导者、领先者

root: leader 由 lead 加施事后缀构成。lead 出自古英语 lǣdan「带领」，与 līþan「行走」相关的使役形式；这个后缀标记执行者。更早的日耳曼来源属于重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one figure: the one who goes first. The figure is a guide of people, a head of an institution, a runner in front, a top firm, a leading article, a line ahead of the fly, a first violinist and a mountain guide.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个人物展开：走在最前面的那一个。这个人物依次是人群的引导者、机构首脑、跑在前面的选手、顶尖企业、头篇评论、假饵前的线、首席小提琴手与登山向导。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the walker at the front who turns to check the column.
core.cn: 核心意象：走在最前面、回头清点队伍的人。

branches.en: THE GUIDE: whether on a trail or in a meeting, the leader is the one who knows the way and walks ahead.
branches.cn: 向导：无论在林间小径上还是在会议中，领导者都是识路并走在前面的人。

branches.en: THE OFFICE: a large body needs a person at the top of its chart.
branches.cn: 职位：庞大的机构需要在组织图顶端有一个人。

branches.en: THE FRONT: a race and a market both measure who is furthest ahead.
branches.cn: 最前：赛跑与市场都在衡量谁跑得最远。

branches.en: THE LEADING WORD: the article at the head of the opinion page speaks for the paper.
branches.cn: 领头之言：评论版最前面的文章代表报纸发言。

branches.en: THE FIRST IN LINE: a fishing trace and a first violin both stand ahead of the rest.
branches.cn: 队列之首：钓鱼前导线与首席小提琴都站在其余之前。

intro.en: The noun can be read from an Old English verb of going, its causative partner and the agent ending that marks the doer.
intro.cn: 这个名词可以按表示行走的古英语动词、它的使役对应词以及标记执行者的施事后缀逐段读出。

latinIntro.en: This word is native English rather than Latin: the Germanic walking root supplies the verb, and the agent ending marks the person.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词是英语本族词而非拉丁借词：日耳曼语中表示行走的词根提供动词，施事后缀标记人。

items.example: The old verb named ordinary movement.
items.exampleCN: 这个古动词指普通移动。

items.example: The causative verb added the idea of conducting others.
items.exampleCN: 这个使役动词增添了带领他人的意思。

items.example: He led the team through the gate.
The ending marks the person who performs the action.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀标记执行动作的人。

items.example: The leader waited at the fork in the path.
The leading car turned off the highway.
items.exampleCN: 领头的那辆车驶离了公路。

items.example: She led the group down the ridge.
The team turned to her for leadership.
A false sign misled the hikers.
items.exampleCN: 一块错误的牌子误导了徒步者。

items.example: The leaderless group drifted apart.
items.exampleCN: 这个没有领导的群体逐渐散开。

definition_zh: 小心地；仔细地；认真地
definition_en: in a way that pays close attention to avoid mistakes or harm
core_image: 踩着薄冰过河，每一步都先试一试
scene: 美术课上，她小心地沿着线剪下那张窗花。 In art class she cut along the line carefully with her scissors.
sceneCN: 这里 carefully 是「小心地」（第 1 个义项：以留神的方式做事）；句意为美术课上沿细线小心剪纸。

derivatives.zh: 其形容词原级，义为「小心的」
由 careless 加 -ness 构成，义为「粗心」

senses.title: In an attentive, safe manner
senses.definition: doing something with attention so nothing goes wrong
senses.definitionCN: 专心留意、不出差错地做事
senses.example: He carried the hot soup carefully.
senses.exampleCN: 他小心地端着热汤。
senses.why: Adverbs describe how an action moves, so careful becomes the manner of the deed.
senses.whyCN: 副词描绘动作的姿势，形容词便化作行动的方式。

senses.title: In a thorough, exact manner
senses.definition: doing something with close, exact attention
senses.definitionCN: 极细致、力求准确地进行
senses.example: Read the question carefully before answering.
senses.exampleCN: 答题前先仔细读题。
senses.why: The same slow watchfulness applied to study becomes precision.
senses.whyCN: 同样的慢而专注用到学习上，便是精确。

intro.en: Carefully stacks three small pieces: care plus ful plus ly.
intro.cn: carefully 由三块小积木搭成：care 加 ful 加 ly。

items.en: Old English caru again supplies the worry root.
items.cn: 古英语 caru 再度供给忧虑词根。

items.en: Middle English carful named the full-of-care heart.
items.cn: 中古英语 carful 指满心挂念的人。

items.en: The adverb ending -ly turned the adjective into a manner.
items.cn: 副词后缀 -ly 把形容词变成方式。

items.en: French likewise builds adverbs with -ment on adjectives.
items.cn: 法语同样在形容词上加 -ment 构成副词。

items.en: Modern carefully covers both safety and precision.
items.cn: 现代 carefully 兼指安全与精确。

note.en: The first group collects same-family adverbs; the second collects attention adverbs.
note.cn: 第一组收同族副词，第二组收集注类副词。

entries.definition: In a careless manner.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「粗心地」，是反义词。

entries.definition: in a hopeful way
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「满怀希望地」，同用 -fully。

entries.definition: in a quiet way
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「安静地」，同为 -ly 副词。

entries.definition: In a careful, watchful way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「谨慎地」。

entries.definition: With close attention.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「专注地」。

entries.definition: In a soft, kind way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「轻柔地」，动作方式相近。

normalIntro.en: Build carefully piece by piece.
normalIntro.cn: 把 carefully 一块块拼起来记。

normal.en: careful + ly = carefully, three parts in one.
normal.cn: careful 加 ly，三段合一。

normal.en: listen carefully in listening class.
normal.cn: 听力课上仔细听。

normal.en: carelessly is its opposite.
normal.cn: carelessly 是它的反义词。

normal.en: drive carefully when it rains.
normal.cn: 雨天开车要小心。

normal.en: check your spelling carefully.
normal.cn: 仔细检查拼写。

abstract.en: Watch a watchmaker place the tiny gear.
abstract.cn: 想象钟表匠安放细小齿轮。

abstract.en: Feel the pencil stop before every hard word.
abstract.cn: 感受笔尖在每个难词前停顿。

abstract.en: Hear the teacher say the word twice, slowly.
abstract.cn: 听老师把这个词慢慢读两遍。

examples.en: She folded the letter carefully and kept it.
examples.cn: 她小心地把信折好收起。

examples.en: Listen carefully to the tape and fill in the blanks.
examples.cn: 仔细听录音并填空。

examples.en: He checked the answers carefully before handing in.
examples.cn: 交卷前他仔细核对了答案。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「凯尔福力」——凯尔浑身是力也慢慢地走，处处留心。

root: care（关切）+ -ful（充满）+ -ly（方式）→ carefully；同族 careful、carelessness、carelessly。

sensesIntro.en: Carefully describes the manner of a full-of-care heart.
sensesIntro.cn: carefully 描绘一颗装满小心之心的行动姿态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: slow steps that watch before they land
core.cn: 核心意象：落脚之前先看清楚的一步步

branches.en: Safe handling of things
branches.cn: 稳当拿放物件

branches.en: Exact reading and checking
branches.cn: 精确的读与查

branches.en: Carrying hot or fragile things
branches.cn: 端拿热物易碎品

branches.en: Careful study habits
branches.cn: 细致的学习习惯

branches.en: The way careful people move
branches.cn: 细心人的行止

intro.en: Carefully shows how English stacks endings to build adverbs.
intro.cn: carefully 展示英语如何叠缀后缀造副词。

latinIntro.en: No Latin root is involved; three Germanic endings do the work.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词根，全靠三个日耳曼后缀成词。

items.example: He waved happily.
A peaceful lake lay below.
She has a care for animals.
Open the box carefully.
He finished quickly.
The plan went badly.
He carelessly broke the glass.
items.exampleCN: 他毛手毛脚打碎了杯子。

items.example: She waited patiently.

definition_zh: 继续；持续；延续
definition_en: to keep doing something or to go on without stopping
core_image: 脚步不停，故事不讲完
scene: 下起小雨，运动会还是照常进行。 The players continued running in the light rain.
sceneCN: 这里 continue 是「继续」（第 1 个义项：不停下）；句意是选手们冒着小雨继续奔跑。

derivatives.zh: 由 continue 加 -ation 构成，义为「继续；续篇」
由 continue 加 -ous 构成，义为「连续不断的」
由 continue 加 -ity 构成，义为「连续性；连贯」

senses.title: To keep doing something
senses.definition: to start again or keep doing something after a pause
senses.definitionCN: 停顿后再接着做或持续做某事
senses.example: After the break, we continued the experiment.
senses.exampleCN: 休息之后，我们继续做实验。
senses.why: The Latin prefix con- means together and tenere means to hold: hold everything together and do not let go.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 con- 表示「一起」，tenere 表示「握住」，把一切握住不放便是不停。

senses.title: To go on existing or happening
senses.definition: to last or keep happening over a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 在某段时间内不停发生或存在
senses.example: The hot weather continued all week.
senses.exampleCN: 炎热天气持续了一整周。
senses.why: What is held tight does not end quickly.
senses.whyCN: 握得紧的东西不会很快结束。

senses.title: To go on speaking or moving after a stop
senses.definition: to start again after stopping, as in speech or travel
senses.definitionCN: 在言语或行进停顿之后重新开始
senses.example: He paused, then continued with his story.
senses.exampleCN: 他停了停，接着讲他的故事。
senses.why: A held breath released returns to the same sentence.
senses.whyCN: 屏住的呼吸一放，还是回到同一句话。

senses.title: To move to the next part
senses.definition: to pass from one part of a book, list or trip to the next
senses.definitionCN: 从书、清单或旅程的一部分进入下一部分
senses.example: Continue to page ten for the answers.
senses.exampleCN: 答案请翻到第十页。
senses.why: Holding the thread means walking from one part into the next.
senses.whyCN: 握住线头，自然从这一段走到下一段。

intro.en: Continue grows from Latin words for holding on.
intro.cn: continue 生长于拉丁语「坚持握住」的词根。

items.en: Latin tenere meant to hold or keep.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tenere 意为握住、保持。

items.en: Latin continuare meant to join together and make unbroken.
items.cn: 拉丁语 continuare 意为连接、使不间断。

items.en: Latin continuus meant hanging together without a break.
items.cn: 拉丁语 continuus 意为连续不断的。

items.en: Old French continuer carried the unbroken sense.
items.cn: 古法语 continuer 传下「不中断」之义。

items.en: Middle English continuen kept both doing and lasting senses.
items.cn: 中古英语 continuen 保留「接着做」与「延续」两义。

items.en: Modern English continue added story and travel uses.
items.cn: 现代英语 continue 又用于故事连载与行程。

note.en: The first group collects the ten family; the second collects words close in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收 ten 词族，第二组收近义词。

entries.definition: Happening without stopping.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「连续不断的」，与 continue 同根。

entries.definition: The part that continues a story.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「续篇」，同根词。

entries.definition: To hold inside.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「包含」，同源于 tenere。

entries.definition: What is inside a book or box.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「内容」，形近但义不同。

entries.definition: To keep going for a time.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「持续」，侧重时长。

entries.definition: To continue doing.
entries.definitionCN: 短语动词，义为「继续进行」，较口语。

entries.definition: To start again after a stop.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「重新开始」，较正式。

normalIntro.en: Remember continue through holding on.
normalIntro.cn: 从「握住不放」的角度记 continue。

normal.en: tenere means to hold; con- means together.
normal.cn: tenere 意为握住，con- 表示一起。

normal.en: contain and continue share the root.
normal.cn: contain 与 continue 同词根。

normal.en: to be continued ends a TV episode.
normal.cn: 连续剧常用 to be continued 表示「未完待续」。

normal.en: continue doing and continue to do both work.
normal.cn: continue doing 与 continue to do 都正确。

normal.en: continuous describes non-stop rain.
normal.cn: continuous 形容下个不停的雨。

abstract.en: Feel fingers gripping a rope in a long climb.
abstract.cn: 感觉攀爬中攥紧绳子的手指。

abstract.en: See a story book stopping at page one hundred.
abstract.cn: 想象故事书停在第一百页。

abstract.en: Hear rain tapping the window all week.
abstract.cn: 听雨点整周敲着窗户。

examples.en: Continue reading where you stopped last night.
examples.cn: 从昨晚停下的地方接着读。

examples.en: The music continued long after the concert ended.
examples.cn: 音乐会散场后乐声仍久久回荡。

examples.en: Keep trying and continue until the finish line.
examples.cn: 坚持住，一直跑到终点线。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯踢牛」——再累也「肯踢牛」般一步不停，continue 就是继续。

root: 拉丁语 con-（一起）+ tenere（握住）→ continuus（连续的）→ continuare（使不间断）→ 古法语 continuer → 中古英语 continuen → 现代英语 continue；同族词有 contain（包含）、continuous（连续的）、tenant（租户）。

sensesIntro.en: Continue holds on to actions, weather, speech and the next page.
sensesIntro.cn: continue「握住不放」：接着做、持续着、接着讲、翻下页。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand that refuses to let go
core.cn: 核心意象：一只不肯松开的手

branches.en: The experiment after the break
branches.cn: 休息后继续的实验

branches.en: A week of hot weather
branches.cn: 持续一周的炎热

branches.en: A storyteller taking a breath
branches.cn: 换气后接着讲的故事

branches.en: Turning to page ten
branches.cn: 翻到第十页

branches.en: A runner who never stops
branches.cn: 从不停步的跑者

intro.en: Continue belongs to the ten family of holding words.
intro.cn: continue 属于表示「握持」的 ten 词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin root ten means to hold.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根 ten 意为握住。

items.meaning: the next part of a story
items.example: The film left room for a continuation.
Three days of continuous rain flooded the road.
The show keeps continuity between episodes.

definition_zh: 公寓；一套房间；套房
definition_en: a set of rooms to live in inside a larger building, or a suite in a hotel
core_image: 车站旁一栋楼里亮着灯的一套房
scene: 车站附近有一栋楼房，其中一套房间亮着灯。 They live in a small apartment near the station.
sceneCN: 这里 apartment 是「公寓」（第 1 个义项：楼里的一套住房）；句意为他们住在车站附近的一间小公寓里。

senses.title: A home inside a building
senses.definition: a set of rooms used as a home inside a larger building
senses.definitionCN: 在一栋较大建筑内用作住所的一套房间
senses.example: They live in a small apartment near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在车站附近的一间小公寓里。
senses.why: The root meant to set apart, so rooms marked off for one household are the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为分开，所以划给一户人家的房间就是第一义。

senses.title: A suite in a hotel
senses.definition: a set of rooms rented as one unit in a hotel
senses.definitionCN: 旅馆中作为一整单元出租的一组房间
senses.example: The hotel gave us a large apartment with two beds.
senses.exampleCN: 旅馆给了我们一间有两张床的大套房。
senses.why: The same set-apart rooms serve travellers for a short stay, which gives the hotel sense.
senses.whyCN: 同样被单独分出的一组房间供旅客短住，于是有旅馆套房的义项。

intro.en: The recorded history of apartment is set out below; the deeper origin is marked where it is uncertain.
intro.cn: 下面是 apartment 有记录的历史；更早的来源存疑处已作标注。

items.en: Appartare meant to separate or to set apart.
items.cn: appartare 意为分开或放到一边。

items.en: Appartamento named a set of rooms set apart.
items.cn: appartamento 指被单独分出的一组房间。

items.en: French borrowed the word for a set of rooms to live in.
items.cn: 法语借入这个词，指一套居住的房间。

items.en: English took apartment for rooms marked off in a building.
items.cn: 英语十七世纪借入 apartment，指楼内划出的一套房间。

items.en: Today it often means a flat in a block or a hotel suite.
items.cn: 今天它常指公寓楼中的一套住房或旅馆套房。

note.en: The first group collects forms that look or sound alike; the second group collects words with a nearby meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收形近或音近的词，第二组收意义相近的词。

entries.definition: It looks close but means a division of an organisation.
entries.definitionCN: 外观相近，但指机构中的一个部门。

entries.definition: It stresses a set of rooms used together.

normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用有记录的词形、真实的词族和这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: The Italian root meant to set apart: an apartment is the part of a building marked off for one household.
normal.cn: 意大利语词根意为分开：apartment 就是一栋楼里划给一户人家的那一部分。

normal.en: The same family also gives apart and part.
normal.cn: 同一词族还给出 apart 与 part。

normal.en: It often appears in the phrase a small apartment.
normal.cn: 它常出现在「一间小公寓」这个搭配里。

normal.en: Spell it as it sounds: keep every letter of apartment in order.
normal.cn: 按读音拼写：把 apartment 的每个字母按顺序保留。

abstract.cn: 想象车站旁一栋楼里亮着灯的一套房。

abstract.en: The same picture can be literal in one sentence and figurative in another.
abstract.cn: 同一幅画面在一句里可以是字面意思，在另一句里可以是比喻。

abstract.cn: 先把这个词读出声，再让画面把意思带回来。

branches.cn: 义项 02 覆盖更宽泛的日常用法：套房。

definition_zh: 装满；填满；充满；填补（空缺）；填充物；饱
definition_en: to put enough of something into a space until it is full, or to take a job or role; also the material used to fill
core_image: 水壶被一股水流缓缓注满，水面最终齐了壶口
scene: 加油站里，司机拧开油箱盖准备加满油。 Please fill the tank with regular petrol.
sceneCN: 这里 fill 是动词，指「把容器装满」，对应第 1 个义项；句意为请给油箱加满普通汽油。

derivatives.zh: 馅料；补牙材料；填充（fill 的动名词，指被填之物）
填充物；补白（fill 加施动者后缀 -er，指用于填充之物）
履行；实现（fill 的同族变体，指完全填满义务或期望）

senses.title: To make a container full
senses.definition: to put as much as possible into a container or space
senses.definitionCN: 把容器或空间装到最满
senses.example: She filled the kettle with water.
senses.exampleCN: 她把水壶装满水。
senses.why: Pouring in until the brim is reached is the picture the word was born from.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的画面就是一直倒入直至齐口。

senses.title: To occupy a space or time
senses.definition: to spread through a space or period
senses.definitionCN: 弥漫于空间或时段之中
senses.example: Music filled the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐充满了大厅。
senses.why: What pours in can be sound or smoke: space is a container too.
senses.whyCN: 涌入的可以是声音或烟雾：空间本身就是容器。

senses.title: To take a job or role
senses.definition: to take or occupy a job, position or need
senses.definitionCN: 承担职位或满足需求
senses.example: Two new teachers filled the vacancies.
senses.exampleCN: 两位新教师填补了空缺。
senses.why: A vacancy is a hole in the roster, and holes ask to be filled.
senses.whyCN: 空缺是名单上的洞，洞等待被填。

senses.title: To complete a form or order
senses.definition: to write in the parts of a form, or to supply what an order asks
senses.definitionCN: 在表格中写入内容，或按订单供货
senses.example: Please fill in your name and address.
senses.exampleCN: 请填写姓名与地址。
senses.why: An empty form is a waiting container for ink and facts.
senses.whyCN: 空表格是等待墨水与事实的容器。

senses.title: Food that satisfies hunger
senses.definition: food that makes you feel full
senses.definitionCN: 令人产生饱感的食物
senses.example: Porridge is cheap and filling.
senses.exampleCN: 粥便宜又顶饱。
senses.why: The stomach is a container, and fill works on it like any other.
senses.whyCN: 胃也是容器，fill 对它一视同仁。

intro.en: Fill is a Germanic word of the full family: the adjective full turned into the verb of making full.
intro.cn: fill 属日耳曼语「满」家族：形容词 full 转化为「使满」的动词。

items.en: A reconstructed root ful- meant 'full'; the verb stem fulljan meant 'to make full'.
items.cn: 一般认为，重构词根 ful- 意为「满」；动词词干 fulljan 意为「使满」。

items.en: Old English fyllan meant 'to fill, complete', a causative of full.
items.cn: 古英语 fyllan 意为「装满、完成」，是 full 的使动形式。

items.en: Middle English fillen kept the causative sense for containers and roles alike.
items.cn: 中古英语 fillen 的使动义兼指容器与职位。

items.en: Phrasal verbs filled in, filled up and filled out spread the idea to forms and shapes.
items.cn: 现代英语短语 fill in、fill up、fill out 把概念扩展到表格与体形。

items.en: The noun grew for dental fillings, pie fillings and fuel fills.
items.cn: 名词义扩展到补牙材料、馅料与加油量。

note.en: Look-alikes share the full root or close spelling; near-meaning words occupy the space of fullness.
note.cn: 形近组共享 full 词根或相近拼写；近义组处于「满」的义场。

entries.definition: containing as much as possible; the adjective behind the verb
entries.definitionCN: 满的；动词背后的形容词

entries.definition: to carry out or complete
entries.definitionCN: 履行；实现；同族强化的「满」

entries.definition: to put goods or cargo into

entries.definition: to push material into a space
entries.definitionCN: 把材料塞入空间

entries.definition: to be full to the very edge
entries.definitionCN: 满到边缘；充盈

normalIntro.cn: 五个来自 full 词族与短语的记忆抓手。

normal.en: fill and full are the same family: to fill is to make full.
normal.cn: fill 与 full 同族：fill 就是使 full。

normal.en: fill in a form writes into the empty lines.
normal.cn: fill in a form 即在空行里填写。

normal.en: fill up the tank takes it to the very top.
normal.cn: fill up the tank 把油加到顶。

normal.en: a filling meal fills the stomach.
normal.cn: filling meal 就是吃饱的一餐。

normal.en: fulfil goes further: it fills an expectation completely.
normal.cn: fulfil 更进一步：把期望填满。

abstract.en: Every empty thing is a question; to fill is to answer it.
abstract.cn: 凡空缺皆提问；fill 就是作答。

abstract.en: Joy poured in fills a life to the brim.
abstract.cn: 倾注的喜悦把生命盛到齐口。

abstract.en: Time is a jug: some days fill slowly, some spill fast.
abstract.cn: 时间是一只壶：有的日子慢慢盛满，有的匆匆溢出。

examples.en: Fill the bucket halfway before you start.
examples.cn: 开始前先把桶装到一半。

examples.en: Her kindness filled the whole office with warmth.
examples.cn: 她的善意让整个办公室充满暖意。

examples.en: The dentist replaced the old filling in my tooth.
examples.cn: 牙医更换了我牙上的旧填充物。

sensesIntro.en: From pouring into containers outward to occupying space, filling jobs, forms and stomachs.

branches.en: THE VESSEL: filling containers.
branches.cn: 容器：把器皿装满。

branches.en: THE SPACE: sound and light that fill rooms.
branches.cn: 空间：充满房间的声与光。

branches.en: THE ROLE: vacancies that take people.
branches.cn: 职位：吸纳人的空缺。

branches.en: THE FORM: lines that wait for ink.

branches.en: THE STOMACH: food that satisfies.

latinIntro.en: Latin used plenus 'full', giving plenty and plenty-family words, unrelated to the Germanic line.

definition_zh: 肩膀；承担；路肩；用肩挤
definition_en: the joint between the neck and arm, to carry a burden, the edge of a road, or to push with the shoulder
core_image: 背包带压在肩上，人微微侧身把重量扛住
scene: 他把包甩到肩上。 He swung the bag onto his shoulder.
sceneCN: 这里 shoulder 是「肩膀」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把包甩到肩上。

senses.title: The body joint
senses.definition: the part of the body where the arm joins the neck and back
senses.definitionCN: 手臂与颈部和背部相连的身体部位
senses.example: He swung the bag onto his shoulder.
senses.exampleCN: 他把包甩到肩上。
senses.why: This is the basic body-part sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的身体部位义项。

senses.title: To bear a burden
senses.definition: to accept responsibility for something difficult
senses.definitionCN: 接受困难事情的责任
senses.example: She shouldered the blame alone.
senses.exampleCN: 她独自承担了责任。
senses.why: The body part becomes a metaphor for carrying.
senses.whyCN: 身体部位转化为承载的隐喻。

senses.title: The road edge
senses.definition: the strip of ground beside a road
senses.definitionCN: 道路旁边的狭长地带
senses.example: The car stopped on the shoulder.
senses.exampleCN: 汽车停在路肩上。
senses.why: The shoulder sits at the edge, like the body part.
senses.whyCN: 路肩位于边缘，正如肩膀在身体两侧。

senses.title: To push through
senses.definition: to push forward using the shoulder
senses.definitionCN: 用肩膀向前推挤
senses.example: He shouldered his way to the front.
senses.exampleCN: 他用肩膀挤到前面。
senses.why: The joint becomes a tool for force.
senses.whyCN: 关节变成了施力的工具。

branches.en: The arm meets the body.

branches.en: The road has its own sides.

branches.en: The joint becomes a pushing tool.

intro.cn: shoulder 构成表示承载与体型的复合词。

definition_zh: 电影；影片；胶卷；薄膜；拍摄
definition_en: a movie, the thin coating on a surface, or the act of recording with a camera
core_image: 一层会讲故事的膜：早期电影正是涂在薄胶片上的影子
scene: 老式放映机把光打在幕布上，观众席渐渐安静。 They filmed the whole ceremony in one afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 film 作动词「拍摄」（第 3 个义项：用摄影机记录）；句意为他们用一个下午拍完了整场典礼。

derivatives.zh: film 加 maker 构成，指电影制作人
加形容词后缀，义为「薄雾般的、朦胧的」
micro 加 film，指缩微胶片

senses.title: A thin layer on a surface
senses.definition: a thin layer of something covering a surface
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖在表面上的某种薄层
senses.example: A film of oil floated on the water.
senses.exampleCN: 水面上浮着一层薄油。
senses.why: The core image is a skin-thin coating, which is the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是薄如皮肤的一层膜，这是最古老的义项。

senses.title: A movie
senses.definition: a story recorded as moving pictures shown in a cinema or on screens
senses.definitionCN: 以活动影像形式放映的故事
senses.example: We watched a film about the polar bears.
senses.exampleCN: 我们看了一部关于北极熊的电影。
senses.why: Early movies were literally moving pictures on a thin film, so the movie sense grew out of the coating.
senses.whyCN: 早期电影正是拍在薄胶片上的活动影像，电影义从涂层义长出。

senses.title: To record with a camera
senses.definition: to use a camera to record moving pictures
senses.definitionCN: 用摄影机记录活动影像
senses.example: The crew filmed the interview at the harbor.
senses.exampleCN: 摄制组在海港拍摄了那次访谈。
senses.why: If the picture lives on film, making it is filming.
senses.whyCN: 影像活在胶片上，制作它就是拍摄。

senses.title: A thin haze over the eyes
senses.definition: a thin layer of tears or mist that blurs the sight
senses.definitionCN: 泪水或雾气形成的薄层，使视线模糊
senses.example: Tears filmed over her eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 泪水在她眼里蒙上了一层雾。
senses.why: The coating sense applies to the eye itself.
senses.whyCN: 涂层义套用到了眼睛上。

intro.en: Film first meant any thin skin, and only later grew into cinema.
intro.cn: film 先泛指薄皮，后来才长出电影义。

items.en: Old English film meant a thin skin, such as a membrane.
items.cn: 古英语 film 指薄皮、薄膜。

items.en: The thin-layer sense continued through Middle English.
items.cn: 薄层义贯穿中古英语。

items.en: Photographers called coated celluloid film, and movies took the name.
items.cn: 现代英语中摄影者把涂感光乳剂的赛璐珞称为 film，电影因此得名。

items.en: The verb to film followed the noun into cinema language.
items.cn: 动词 to film 随名词进入电影用语。

items.en: The modern language keeps the word in daily use.
items.cn: 现代英语仍在日常使用该词。

note.en: Film crosses movies, coatings and cameras, which trips up many learners.
note.cn: film 横跨电影、涂层与相机，学习者容易绊倒。

entries.definition: adjective meaning thin and misty
entries.definitionCN: 形容词：如薄膜般朦胧的

entries.definition: one letter shorter; to make full
entries.definitionCN: 填满；与 film 仅差一字母

entries.definition: a factory with heavy machines; similar shape
entries.definitionCN: 磨坊、工厂；字形相近但词源不同

entries.definition: the everyday American word for a film
entries.definitionCN: 电影的美式日常说法

entries.definition: the place where films are shown
entries.definitionCN: 放映电影的场所

entries.definition: a thin soft layer in biology
entries.definitionCN: 生物学中的薄膜，对应 film 的旧义

normalIntro.en: Five hooks to keep film in focus.
normalIntro.cn: 五条钩子让 film 保持对焦。

normal.en: Old movies ran on strips of film, thin as a skin.
normal.cn: 老电影跑在薄如皮肤的一卷卷胶片上。

normal.en: A film of dust on the desk means nobody cleaned it.
normal.cn: 桌上的一层薄灰说明没人打扫。

normal.en: Go to the cinema and you see a film, not a membrane.
normal.cn: 去电影院看的是电影，不是薄膜。

normal.en: Filmy curtains are as thin as a film layer.
normal.cn: 薄纱窗帘像薄膜一样薄。

normal.en: The crew filmed the scene twice because of the rain.
normal.cn: 因为下雨，剧组把那场戏拍了两遍。

abstract.en: Film is a skin that remembers light.
abstract.cn: film 是一层记得住光的皮肤。

abstract.en: Picture a pond wearing a coat of oil.
abstract.cn: 想象一个池塘披着油的外套。

abstract.en: Every movie is a membrane between you and another life.
abstract.cn: 每部电影都是你与另一种人生之间的一层膜。

examples.en: That film made everyone in the hall laugh.
examples.cn: 那部电影让全场的人都笑了。

examples.en: A film of ice covered the quiet lake.
examples.cn: 一层薄冰覆盖着安静的湖面。

examples.en: They filmed the parade from a rooftop.
examples.cn: 他们在屋顶上拍摄了游行。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「菲尔姆」——胶片薄薄一层像菲薄的膜；film 就是那层记录影像的膜

root: 古英语 film（薄膜），一般认为源自表示「皮、膜」的日耳曼词根；现代的电影义由感光胶片义发展而来，非拉丁来源。

sensesIntro.en: From thin coating to moving pictures and back to misty eyes.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从薄涂层出发，长出电影与拍摄，又回到眼前的薄雾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a skin-thin layer that holds light
core.cn: 核心意象：薄如皮肤、能留住光的一层

branches.en: any thin layer on a surface
branches.cn: 表面上的任意薄层

branches.en: the story shown from the strip
branches.cn: 由胶片放映出的故事

branches.en: the act of recording
branches.cn: 记录影像的动作

branches.en: the mist before the eyes
branches.cn: 眼前的泪雾

branches.en: the shared membrane idea
branches.cn: 贯穿两者的薄膜概念

intro.en: Film is a short Old English noun that later built compounds freely.
intro.cn: film 是短小的古英语名词，后来大量参与构词。

latinIntro.en: Latin relatives are absent; compounds were formed inside English.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词，复合词都在英语内部构成。

items.example: Old film named membranes before cinema.
items.exampleCN: cinema 出现前，古英语 film 已指薄膜。

items.example: The filmmaker won an award.
The film star waved to the crowd.
Libraries kept old newspapers on microfilm.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆用缩微胶片保存旧报纸。

items.example: They made a telefilm about the flood.
items.exampleCN: 他们拍了一部关于洪水的电视电影。

items.example: A filmy skirt floated in the wind.
The moment is on film forever.
She covered the bowl with cling film.

items.meaning: to become covered with a thin layer
items.example: His eyes filmed over with tears.

items.meaning: the music written for a film
items.example: The film score swelled at the ending.

latinEntries.example: Membrane is the Latin cousin of the coating sense.
latinEntries.exampleCN: membrane 是涂层义的拉丁表亲。

definition_zh: 平静的；镇静的；风平浪静的；使平静
definition_en: quiet and not worried, still and without wind, or to make someone or something quiet
core_image: 无风的海面像镜子一样平
scene: 暴风雨过后，海面重新变得平静。 After the storm the sea grew calm again.
sceneCN: 这里 calm 是「风平浪静的」（第 3 个义项：海面或天气无风无浪）；句意为暴风雨过后海面重新平静下来。

pos.zh: 形容词：平静的；镇静的；风平浪静的

derivatives.zh: 由 calm 加 -ly 构成，义为「平静地」
由 calm 加 -ness 构成，义为「平静；镇定」
由 be- 加 calm 构成，义为「使静止无风」

senses.title: Not worried or excited
senses.definition: quiet and peaceful, not worried or excited
senses.definitionCN: 安静平和，不焦虑也不激动
senses.example: She stayed calm while the others shouted.
senses.exampleCN: 别人都在喊叫时她保持镇静。
senses.why: The word first described the still air of a windless day, then the same stillness inside a person.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初形容无风之日的静止空气，后来也形容人内心的同样静止。

senses.title: To make someone quiet
senses.definition: to make a person or animal become quiet and relaxed
senses.definitionCN: 使人或动物安静放松下来
senses.example: The nurse calmed the frightened child.
senses.exampleCN: 护士安抚了受惊的孩子。
senses.why: If wind can drop, a person can be made to drop too, so the adjective turned into a verb.
senses.whyCN: 风能停下来，人也能被安抚下来，于是形容词变成了动词。

senses.title: Still, without wind
senses.definition: of the sea or weather, still and without wind
senses.definitionCN: 指海面或天气静止无风
senses.example: After the storm the sea grew calm again.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨过后海面重新平静下来。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: the flat, unbroken surface of water on a windless day.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的意思：无风之日平坦无波的水面。

intro.en: Calm probably comes from Greek kauma, the heat of midday, when the wind dies and the sea goes flat.
intro.cn: calm 很可能来自希腊语 kauma，指正午的炎热，那时风停息，海面变平。

items.en: Kauma meant the burning heat of noon, the hour when the wind falls.
items.cn: kauma 指正午灼热，那是风停下来的时刻。

items.en: Latin cauma kept the sense of midday heat and stillness.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cauma 保留了正午炎热与静止的意思。

items.en: Italian calma shifted from heat to the stillness of the air and sea.
items.cn: 意大利语 calma 从炎热转向空气与海面的静止。

items.en: French calme carried the quiet of weather into English.
items.cn: 法语 calme 把天气的平静带进了英语。

items.en: English extended calm from the sea to the mind and made it a verb.
items.cn: 英语把 calm 从海面扩展到内心，并把它变成了动词。

note.en: The first group collects words close in shape or sound; the second collects quiet feelings.
note.cn: 第一组收形近或音近的词，第二组收安静情绪的词。

entries.definition: To telephone or shout.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「打电话；呼喊」，与 calm 只差末字母。

entries.definition: The inner surface of the hand.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「手掌」，拼写与 calm 接近。

entries.definition: A soothing oil or cream.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「香脂；安慰物」，韵脚与 calm 相同。

entries.definition: Making little or no noise.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「安静的」。

entries.definition: Free from trouble or noise.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「和平的；安宁的」。

entries.definition: Not moving at all.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「静止的」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the recorded Greek and Italian origin, the real derivatives and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用有记录的希腊语与意大利语来源、真实派生词和这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Greek kauma was the noon heat, the hour when the wind drops and the sea flattens.
normal.cn: 希腊语 kauma 指正午的炎热，那时风停、海面变平。

normal.en: Italian calma moved from heat to stillness, and English borrowed that stillness.
normal.cn: 意大利语 calma 从炎热转向静止，英语借来的正是这份静止。

normal.en: A calm sea and a calm mind share the same flat, unbroken surface.
normal.cn: 平静的海与平静的心共享同一片平坦无波的水面。

normal.en: It often pairs with down, keep, stay and sea.
normal.cn: 它常与 down、keep、stay、sea 搭配。

normal.en: Spell c-a-l-m; the l is silent, so it sounds like karm.
normal.cn: 拼写是 c-a-l-m，其中 l 不发音，读起来像 karm。

abstract.en: See a mirror-flat sea with no wind: that surface is calm.
abstract.cn: 想象一片没有风、像镜子一样平的海面：那片水面就是 calm。

abstract.en: Let a worried face mirror that flat water and it becomes a calm mind.
abstract.cn: 让一张焦虑的脸映出那片平水，它就变成了平静的心。

abstract.en: Hold the flat sea in mind and it will flatten your worry when you say the word.
abstract.cn: 记住那片平海，说这个词时它会把你的焦虑也抚平。

examples.en: She stayed calm while the others shouted.
examples.cn: 别人都在喊叫时她保持镇静。

examples.en: The nurse calmed the frightened child.
examples.cn: 护士安抚了受惊的孩子。

examples.en: After the storm the sea grew calm again.
examples.cn: 暴风雨过后海面重新平静下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「卡姆」——无风的海面像镜子一样平：平静的

root: calm 很可能来自希腊语 kauma，指正午的灼热，那是一天中风停下来、海面变平的时刻。这个词经拉丁语 cauma 进入意大利语，写成 calma，意思从炎热转到空气与海面的静止，再由法语 calme 传入英语。英语先用它形容风平浪静的海，随后扩展到人内心的平静，最后又变成动词，表示把人安抚下来。

sensesIntro.en: The three senses of calm grow from one picture: a flat surface with no wind on it.
sensesIntro.cn: calm 的三个义项都从同一个画面生长出来：一片没有风的平坦水面。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a windless sea as flat as a mirror
core.cn: 核心意象：无风的海面像镜子一样平

branches.en: THE MIND: the quiet feeling is the everyday sense.
branches.cn: 内心线：安静的情绪是最常用的义项。

branches.en: THE SOOTHING: the verb makes someone quiet.
branches.cn: 安抚线：动词使人安静下来。

branches.en: THE SEA: the windless surface is the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 海面线：无风的水面是最古老的意思。

branches.en: THE STILLNESS: mind and sea share the same flat quiet.
branches.cn: 静止线：内心与海面共享同样的平坦安静。

branches.en: THE CHANGE: the verb moves a person into that quiet.
branches.cn: 转变线：动词把人带进那份安静。

intro.en: Calm is a base adjective and verb, so the items below are its endings and the words it joins.
intro.cn: calm 是基础形容词兼动词，下面列出的是它的词尾以及与之组合的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin cauma is the recorded form behind the word, and tranquillus is a Latin parallel for the meaning calm.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cauma 是这个词背后的有记录形式，tranquillus 则是与 calm 同义的拉丁语平行词。

items.example: It forms calmer.
It forms calmest.
It forms calmly.
It forms calmness.
It forms becalm.
It forms calms.
It forms calmed.
It forms calming.

definition_zh: 关于；大约；到处；在附近
definition_en: on the subject of something, or roughly, or in many places
core_image: 几个人围着一张地图讨论
scene: 课间，几个同学围着一张地图讨论春游路线。 They talked about the trip for an hour.
sceneCN: 这里 about 是「关于」（第 1 个义项：涉及某主题）；句意为他们谈论这次旅行谈了一个小时。

senses.title: On the subject of
senses.definition: on the subject of something
senses.definitionCN: 以某事为谈论的话题
senses.example: We talked about the film.
senses.exampleCN: 我们谈论了这部电影。
senses.why: About first meant around, and a topic is what a talk circles around, so it came to mean on the subject of.
senses.whyCN: about 原义是「在周围」，话题正是一段谈话围着转的东西，于是表示关于。

senses.title: Roughly a number
senses.definition: close to a number but not exact
senses.definitionCN: 接近某个数目但不精确
senses.example: About twenty pupils came.
senses.exampleCN: 大约来了二十名学生。
senses.why: The sense of around moved from space to number, giving the meaning of roughly.
senses.whyCN: 「在周围」从空间转到数目，就得到大约的意思。

senses.title: In various places
senses.definition: in many places around a area
senses.definitionCN: 在一个区域内的多处地方
senses.example: They walked about the town.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在镇上四处走动。
senses.why: This keeps the oldest spatial picture: moving around within a place.
senses.whyCN: 这里保留最古老的空间画面：在一个地方内部四处走动。

senses.title: Just going to
senses.definition: used with to for something that will happen very soon
senses.definitionCN: 与 to 连用，表示某事马上就要发生
senses.example: The train is about to leave.
senses.exampleCN: 火车就要开了。
senses.why: The picture of being around a point became being on the edge of an event, so about to marks what is just ahead.
senses.whyCN: 「在某一点周围」的画面变成「处在事件的边缘」，所以 about to 标记马上要做的事。

intro.en: The recorded history of about is set out below; the deeper origin is marked where it is uncertain.
intro.cn: 下面是 about 有记录的历史；更早的来源存疑处已作标注。

items.en: Abutan meant around or on the outside of a thing.
items.cn: abutan 意为在某物的周围或外侧。

items.en: The parts meant on and outside, so the word pictured the outer side.
items.cn: 其成分意为「在」与「外面」，词描绘的是外侧。

items.en: The word came to mean around a place and nearly, as in a number.
items.cn: 这个词逐渐表示在某处周围，以及数字上的将近。

items.en: Talk about a thing came to mean talk concerning it.
items.cn: talk about 逐渐表示谈论与它有关的内容。

items.en: Today it is one of the most common words in English.
items.cn: 今天它是英语中最常用的词之一。

note.en: The first group collects forms that look or sound alike; the second group collects words with a nearby meaning.
note.cn: 第一组收形近或音近的词，第二组收意义相近的词。

entries.definition: A complete turn of direction or opinion.
entries.definitionCN: 方向或意见的彻底转变。

entries.definition: A turn to face the other way.
entries.definitionCN: 转身面向另一边。

entries.definition: A longer way of saying around.
entries.definitionCN: 表示「周围」的较长说法。

entries.definition: It covers movement on all sides of a place.
entries.definitionCN: 指在某处四周移动。

entries.definition: It means on the subject of, in a formal tone.
entries.definitionCN: 正式用语，意为关于。

entries.definition: It means about, when a number is not exact.
entries.definitionCN: 表示数字不精确的大约。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the recorded form, the real family and the phrases the word actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子使用有记录的词形、真实的词族和这个词实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: a- means on and butan means outside: about first meant on the outside, then around, then concerning.
normal.cn: a- 表示在，butan 表示外面：about 先表示在外侧，再表示周围，又引申为关于。

normal.en: The same family also gives about-face and about-turn.
normal.cn: 同一词族还给出 about-face 与 about-turn。

normal.en: It often appears in the phrase talk about.
normal.cn: 它常出现在「谈论」这个搭配里。

normal.en: Spell it as it sounds: keep every letter of about in order.
normal.cn: 按读音拼写：把 about 的每个字母按顺序保留。

normal.en: Use it when you mean: on the subject of something, or roughly, or in many places.
normal.cn: 当你想表达「关于」时用它。

abstract.en: Picture several people around a map, talking.
abstract.cn: 想象几个人围着一张地图讨论。

abstract.en: The same picture can be literal in one sentence and figurative in another.
abstract.cn: 同一幅画面在一句里可以是字面意思，在另一句里可以是比喻。

abstract.en: Say the word aloud first, then let the picture bring the meaning back.
abstract.cn: 先把这个词读出声，再让画面把意思带回来。

examples.en: We talked about the film.
examples.cn: 我们谈论了这部电影。

examples.en: About twenty pupils came.
examples.cn: 大约来了二十名学生。

examples.en: They walked about the town.
examples.cn: 他们在镇上四处走动。

sensesIntro.en: Every sense of about grows from one core image: several people around a map, talking.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: several people around a map, talking
